text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PROD: eu-north-1 / az4; symptom: elevated 5xx + control-plane retry loops. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-7412. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident/runbooks/az-network-failover. Auto-escalate in 2m if no ack.

emma: ACK. I'm on call. taking initial triage. @raj if you can shadow until we decide escalation path that'd be great.

emma: quick snapshot: 11:32:15 UTC saw control-plane retransmits, followed by provider NIC errors on a subset of nodes in az4. 5xx rate from clients up ~18% vs baseline. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/alerts/eu-north-1-az4

raj: I'm awake, acknowledging on PD. grabbing `kubectl get events` and node NIC logs now.

pagerduty-bot: INC-7412 acknowledged by emma (oncall).

emma: logs (truncated):
```
[2025-02-22T11:32:18Z] fabric: route-table: BGP withdraw received for prefix 10.4.128.0/22
[2025-02-22T11:32:19Z] nic-driver: link-down on eth1, err=-110
[2025-02-22T11:32:20Z] runtime: shard-7 connection fail, downstream 502
```

raj: node-level kmsg shows repeated `firmware watchdog reset` on nic. suspect transient hardware flaps causing intermittent packet loss -> control-plane retries -> kv cache thrash. Running `rdctl node describe` on affected hosts.

ops: Noted. We have standby capacity in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. Runbook suggests activating routing-fallback to eu-west-1 for affected model shards if eviction rate > 30% for 5m. Current eviction is 42% over 3m.

emma: I'm going to trigger partial fallback for the most impacted model (embedder-v2) to avoid full region failover. Plan: 1) mark shards in az4 as degraded 2) enable fallback routing policy for embedder-v2 to prefer eu-west-1 3) scale up embedder-v2 replicas in eu-west-1 by +25%.

luca: escalating to SRE lead for parallel ops; joining in 1m. @sre-lead FYI.

sre-lead: Good plan. Approve partial fallback. Keep some capacity in eu-north-1 to avoid cold starts. Make sure to set `prefer_fallback: true` but keep `sticky: session` for long running calls to reduce cross-region tokenization variance.

emma: executing step 1:
```
# mark shards
rbctl shards set-status --region eu-north-1 --az az4 --model embedder-v2 --status degraded
```
Response: OK.

emma: executing step 2 -> flip routing policy (temporary):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routing/policies/fallback \
  -d '{"model":"embedder-v2","from":"eu-north-1","to":"eu-west-1","percent":60}'
```
Control plane accepted; change in progress.

incident-bot: Alert -> routing policy change requested. Change ID: ch-9843. Will auto-rollback in 15m if error rate increases.

emma: scaling up replicas in eu-west-1 (scale +25%):
```
rdctl scale --model embedder-v2 --region eu-west-1 --add 6
```
Scaling started; expected ready in ~120s.

raj: watching healthstream. initial A/B shows error-rate drop for routed traffic: embedder-v2 5xx down from 18%->6% in 90s for traffic routed to eu-west-1. Latency up ~30ms but acceptable. Good sign.

pagerduty-bot: INC-7412 auto-escalation suppressed (ack present). Current status: investigating.

sre-lead: good. start notifying top-10 affected customers via support playbook. @ops please prepare a customer-facing blurb: concise, no internal detail, estimated impact window.

ops: Draft blurb: "We're experiencing increased errors for inference in EU-North region; some requests may see errors or higher latency. We're routing impacted traffic to neighboring region; services are recovering. We'll provide an update in 15 minutes." Sending to support for immediate dispatch.

luca: I will take on-call for the next shift. Handoff: emma -> luca. emma, handoff notes: partial fallback active (60% traffic for embedder-v2), scaling actions in flight, affected nodes: eu-north-1 az4 (node IDs: n-314, n-315, n-318). Postmortem owners: emma, raj, luca.

emma: Handoff accepted. Creating incident ticket in JIRA: RED-INC-2025. Assigning Sev2 and timeline.

incident-bot: Escalation: level-2 paged (luca) due to sustained degradation >10m.

luca: verified fallback state: ch-9843 shows 60% fallback to eu-west-1; no rollbacks. Observability: 5xx overall down to 4% cluster-wide. Doing a forced probe across a mix of customers to confirm behavior.

luca: probe sample results:
```
> curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.redwood/v1/embed -H "x-api-key:probe"
200 0.345s
200 0.412s
502 0.678s  # from sessions still landing in az4
```

luca: Mitigation next: cordon problematic nodes in az4 to prevent scheduler from placing new critical pods there; create ticket with infra to schedule hardware inspection for NIC firmware.

raj: cordon done:
```
kubectl cordon n-314 n-315 n-318 -n prod
```
Pods are draining; few evictions observed.

emma: confirm customer impact metrics: top-10 customers saw ~9% failed requests at peak; after fallback, failures reduced to <1% for those with traffic routed. Support notified customers.

sre-lead: Good containment. Keep partial fallback in place until hardware replacement or stable for 60m. Prepare a gradual rollback test in 30m.

ops: note for postmortem: consider adding an automated check to detect NIC firmware flaps and preemptively schedule host failover to spare pool.

luca: assigning follow-ups: hardware escalation INC-FW-314 -> infra-oncall; postmortem owners noted. Will transition to monitoring mode; if we see error-rate creep >2% for 10m, we re-open PD and escalate.

emma: leaving detailed notes in JIRA and Confluence. handoff complete. Keep channel updated with any regression.

pagerduty-bot: INC-7412 status -> acknowledged; last updated by luca at 11:56 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident thread will remain open until monitoring is stable for 60m. Auto-close disabled while owners assigned.

luca: closing triage phase. Current status: partial fallback active, 5xx returned to baseline, customer impact minimized. moving to remediation/repair. will update in 30m or on change. :white_check_mark:
